book.name: Jisas Himache Tau
book.title: Jisas Ri Himache Le Wui Tau

content: Gotri Himamwale kipe sikaro
Ete wowani Pendikos gisi tawani o gisi okwe aka laka fokumbwa wunu tinda ya wu wau.
Wosiwani metengei ete ata laka foti hewen ko tiki ausuwa laka sindau hinga ya gi. Wokoni o ata gale wu linindaro aka laka ki ete raru.
Wowani hi ti tarukwe hinga sirakoni huwa huwa ele hima wui tape tenge tiki funda funda ya wunu liti.
Wosiwani Gotri Himamwale kipe funda wunu talesini wunu okulandawani mwanji ba fo ba fo hinga ya wu bwanda.
O gisi ki, Jerusalem ko tiki Juta hima kupu fwele ele mapwa ele mapwa tokwe tasini ya wu da. Wunu Gotri ni akindau hima.
Ka ata giwani ele hima miyafo wu tani ya wu wau. Wosini wu mendiwani Jisas ri himache le ele hima i mwanji minde hinga wu bwawani ete wu apapana.
Wokoni inaka miyafo wu wohambwakahambwakoni ya wu sawe, “Hinde na hinga? Do mwanji bwandau hima le wunu Galili kipe hima lembwa.
Hinde wowani nui mwanji hinga funda funda wu bwandau? Nu mendiwani nui nuwai yapai bwandau mwanji gale hinga!

Nunu ele ko ele ko ki nu taro, nunu fwele Patiya kipe, fwele Mitiya kipe, e, fwele Ilam kipe. Nunu fwele Mesopotemiya mapwa tokwe nu taro, fwele Jutiya, fwele Kapatosiya, fwele Pondas, e, fwele Esiya,

e, fwele Firisiya, fwele Pamufiliya, fwele Isip, e, fwele Lipiya, Sairini takai ki dau. Nunu fwele Rom ki nu dau Juta hima kupu ga wui sumbu torosindau hima lenga, nu tasini ahaꞌa ki nu dau. Nunu fwele Kuwit kipe, fwele Arepiya kipe. Nunu tinda ete ma nu mendi, nui mwanji ba fo ba fweleki ele Gotri wosiro sumbu laka tini wu bwandau.”
Wokoni ele hima wu apapanani inaka miyafo naha ya wu hambwanda. Wondani wunjenga ka hinga tini ya wu anambwa, “Dohaꞌa bwele sumbu hinga?”
Ete wondani hima fwele ka hinga ya wunu saweholiya, “Waini uku ako miyafo naha asini wu ambwatinambwatindau.”
Pita Gotri mwanji bwaro

Ete wowani Pita ele tapaꞌangi tapaꞌangi hatachi funda lenga ri etisini hapa tinga ri uchani ele himiyama hurahama miyafo leni ka hinga ya ri sawe, “Kunu ele Juta hima kupu, kunu ele hima fwele Jerusalem ku tasini ku dau okwe, kunu wasamba ma ku owesini mwanji ahi ti ku mendini dohaꞌa sumbu ku hambwa.
Kunu hinde ku hambwandau, dele himako ambwatinambwatindauꞌu? Mina. Hinde wowani apambwa nurumbu, 9 kilok ya iu.
Gotri mwanji bwarakarandaro hima Jowel imbihumbwa ri chengi ki ele sumbu ni ka hinga sawero:

content.text: “Gotri ka hinga ya sawe, ‘Gisi jipe takaiwa ai Himamwale kipe ele himiyama hurahama ni humbweno.
Wowa ele kui himiyama hurahama che Gotri mwanji wu bwarakarandano.
Wosini ele kui hima wapa leni a wosiwa wunu tukuyaneheindau hinga ele sumbu ambwe wu heino.
Wosini ele kui mekupu le wu tukuyaneheiwa sumbu fwele wunu a mekusino.
O gisi kumbwa Himamwale kipe ahi ti ai tau ra himiyama hurahama le okwe a humbweno. Wosiwa Gotri mwanji wu bwarakarandano.
Wosini kari kau niri ni a wosiwa sumbu ba fo hinga sirano. E, kari kai nuwe ni a wosiwa sumbu ba fo hinga sirano.
O hinga a wosiwa ka nuwe ki fi tinga hi tinga hiki omwesika laka tinga o sirakonda.
Wosini nika ti a jamekowa o hundukonda. Niliki nika ti a jamekowa naro o sirakonda.
Wowambwa Apukolaka ri gisi ti o sirakonda. O gisi rihi omwesika laka kwambu naha.
Wosiwa hima fwele Apukolaka hi tini mwe naha uchawa wunu okulani raꞌaikonda.” ’

content: Gotri mwanji bwarakarandaro hima Jowel o hinga sawero.

Wosini Pita tombwa ya ri ai sawe, “Kunu Isurel hima kupu le, kunu dohaꞌa mwanji ma ku mendi. Ani Nasaret pe Jisas ni kunu a sawekondau. Kunu ku hambwandau, ka kui nindo tiki ri dasini Gotri kwambu tiki ba fo ba fo sumbu kwambu ri wosindaro ti. O sumbu hinga ri wosindaro ti, oti ku heini ku hambwa kinani, rini Gotri to rini humbwewani ri taro.

Imbihumbwa kapwa Gotri to rinjenga ri hambwani funda bwani mendiro mwanji hinga ori hima ni kui tapa tenge ki ri owero. Wosiwani ele kapwa hima wui tapa tenge tiki rini ku hasini ku sawewani me yapweke tiki rini wu yeni wu siro.
Wosiwani ori hima amwaka mendini ri haro ti, Gotri oti ni rani humbwesini rini ai rasairo. Hinde wowani, o rini eini siro wa ti hinde apa rini toronambusi kumbwa.
E, Defit okwe o hingambwa rini numbwa imbihumbwa ri chengi Sam ki sawero:

content.text: “Ani ani heiwani Apukolaka ri ani ni takaisini ete ri dau.
Rini ani takaisini dani kwambu ti ani handau. Wosiwa sumbu foti hinde ani yetupwa kumbwa.
Wondawani sembe ahi ti kipe naha sukwandawani kipeheki mwanji tumbwa a bwandau. Wosini anjenga mwaꞌambwe kipe tini a nikisindau.
Apa ambusuwa lei ko tiki mi ani hanjaꞌaisiwa a da hinga.
Hima kipe naha mihi ti mi ani hanjaꞌaisiwa wa tiki apa ai tape ti kupwaꞌai hinga.
E, himamwale ako torono numbo ti mi ani mekusihiro.
Mini ani ga ete mi dawa, apa ete ani eripendano.”

content: Defit o hinga ri sawero.

“Ai hiparakambwe le, ma ku mendi. Defit sawero mwanji oti rinjenga ri sawe nambwe. Hinde wowani, rini imbihumbwa ri haro. Wosiwani rini wu eini wu siro. Ri wa mwe ti nui nindo tiki ete da dani apa ya ete da.

Woroti, Defit rini Gotri mwanji bwarakarandaro hima. Rini Gotri rini ga mwanji funda mwe naha fi bwani fi mendiro ka tini ri hambwandaro, “Ichai mi anitafenita forini mini hinga king apukolaka rini ani esikonda.”

Defit o sumbu ni Gotri wosiwa ichai sirano ti rini ri hambwandaro. Wosini Kurais ri ai saino sumbu tini ete ya ri sawe, “Gotri apa rini hanjaꞌaisiwa ambusuwa ko tiki ete ri da hinga. Wosiwa hima tape rihi ti apa kupwaꞌai hinga.”
O mwanji hinga keke Jisas mwe Gotri ai rini rasairo. Nunu tinda ete nu heisini ka hinga nu sawendau.

Apa Jisas hewen ko tiki ri rausini Gotri tapa mama tokwe ya ri dau. Ri Yapai Gotri to Himamwale kipe rihi rini ha kinani sawero hinga ya rini ha. Woro hinga apa o Himamwale ri humbwewani sikawani ka ku mendisini ku heini ku hambwahito.
Defit rini hewen ko tiki ri rau nambwe. Woroti rinjenga imbihumbwa ri chengi Sam ki ete ri sawero:

content.text: “Apukolaka ai Apukolaka ni ka hinga ri sawero:
‘Mini ai tapa mama tokwe mi linindawa
ichai ele mi miho hima a sawewa mi seke tako tiki wu dano.” ’

content: “Apa kunu Isurel pe hima le, ka tini ya ma ku hambwa. Ka me yapweke ki ku yero Jisas Gotri rini ni Apukolaka esisindau. Rini Kurais.” Pita o hinga ya wunu ri sawe.
Himiyama hurahama miyafo sembe wu hawani uku wunu yasiro
O mwanji hinga tini wu mendini sembe amwaka ya wunu a. Wowani Pita ga ele himache fwelenga wunu ni ya wu sawe, “Nui hiparakambwe le, apa hinde hinga nu wosino?”

Wowani Pita ya wunu ri sawe, “Kunu tinda ete funda funda sembe kuhi ti kapwa sumbu kuhi gumwa ma ku sisini Jisas Kurais ri hi tiki uku ti ma ku yawa, Gotri kapwa sumbu kuhi ti sa rani sa rumbwe. O hinga ku wosiwambwa apa Gotri Himamwale kipe rihi ti kunu ri hano.

Imbihumbwa Gotri Himamwale kipe ti kunu ri ha kinani ri sawero ti apa kunu ga kui chechehimache lenga ele himiyama hurahama apahime dau le okwe wunu ri hakondau. Gotri to wunu uchawani rini tambwa wu tawambwa Himamwale kipe rihi ni wunu ri hakondau.”
Wosini Pita ele mwanji fwelenga wunu ri sawesini mwanji kwambu fonga ya wunu ri sawe, “Kunu hambwafwaꞌai, apa ele kapwa hima lenga walambe funda kunu ino keke sembe kuhi ti ma ku ha.”
Wowani ele hima Pita i mwanji ni wu mendini wu sirinawani uku ti ya wunu yasi. Wowani o gisi ki Gotri ele sembe haro hima hinga raꞌaiwani 3,000 hinga ya sukwa.
Jisas ni sembe haro hima anandi lei sumbu kipe
Wosini wunu ele Jisas himache lei mwanji ni kipe naha wu mendini ele hiparakambwe leni wu okulani a funda wu ani, Gotri ni ya funda wu uchahambwanda.
Wondawani ele sembe haro himako Gotri ni wu akindawani Gotri ele himache lei tapa tiki ba fo ba fo sumbu ya ri wosi.
Ete wowani ele himiyama hurahama sembe ti Kurais numbwa wu hasini ya funda wu da. Wosini ele mwaꞌambwe wuhi wu hambwawani funda ete wui mwaꞌambwe hinga.

Wosini ele wui nuwe tipa fwelenga mwaꞌambwe wuhi fwelenga ele hima ga wungwa wu jindaro. Wosini o ya wu torosini wu ratani, ele bwarichape hima, e, ahirahi nambwe hima leni wu humwasini ya wu haꞌi hata.
Wunu sembe funda ete wu dani gisi gisi Gotri aka laka tokwe funda wu indaro. Wunu ele aka ele aka ki wu wausini ahirahi ti funda wu andani sembe kipe naha wu hambwandani ya wu eripenda.

Gisi gisi wunu Gotri hi tini ete wu rasaindawani ele himiyama hurahama wunu heini sembe wuhi ti wunu ni wu eripendaro. Ele gisi hinga Gotri hima fweleni ri ai ratawani sembe ha himako miyafo naha ya inda.
